# `signum`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
signum(expr)
```

Returns -1.0, 0.0 or 1.0 as `expr` is negative, 0 or positive.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT signum(40);
```

Result:

```text
1.0
```

```sql
SELECT signum(INTERVAL -'100' YEAR);
```

Result:

```text
-1.0
```
